scripts.eval:conversations: npm run native:ensure && vitest run --config vitest.conversation.config.ts
scripts.eval:conversations:llm-bot: npm run native:ensure && AI_ENABLED=true tsx src/scripts/eval-conversations-llm-bot.ts
scripts.docker:dev:clean: npm run docker:dev:db:clean && npm run docker:dev
